scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic overcast daytime, dead calm photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms and props where they are, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground becomes real limestone, scree, scrub and dry grass. Shields are plain round bronze, no emblem. One small bleached-linen tent on a hillside clearing, exactly ONE shield leaning beside it, a chest and a wicker basket by it. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its mercenary's dress exactly and its tent. He sits alone at the tent's mouth looking up at the empty sky where one hawk circles high; the basket holds a few ravens. Sea beyond. No other people, no fire. The photo fills the whole frame edge to edge. Nothing modern.

c02-glass.chapter: II · What the Four Owe Each Other
c02-glass.note: The tent's sandglass standing on its chest, close up. People are added in the image pass.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic close-up macro photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Overcast daylight, dead calm. A sandglass stands on the closed lid of a weathered, iron-bound wooden chest: two blown-glass bulbs between turned wooden end plates joined by three slim wooden posts, fine pale sand half run through. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its sandglass and chest. The sandglass fills the centre of the frame, razor sharp; behind it, softly out of focus, the weathered limestone hillside and the edge of a linen tent. Shallow depth of field. No people, no birds, no other objects. Nothing modern.
